newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 6.

text.p: The following are the main events and business expected in parliament on Wednesday.
- Trade and Industry questions at 1430 GMT. - Second reading of the Local Government and Rating Bill starting at about 1530 GMT.

- Foreign Affairs Committee holds inquiry into development of UK links and business in Latin America. Witnesses include Professor Victor Bulmer-Smith, director Institute of Latin American Studies. 1000 GMT.
- Powergen Plc, National Grid Co Plc and South Western Electricity Plc give evidence to the Trade and Industry Committee on Energy Regulation. 1030 GMT.
- Transport Committee questions airlines and National Air Traffic Services on air traffic control 1600 GMT.

- Treasury Committee hears from Securities and Investments Board on Barings Bank and international regulation, 1615 GMT. - Home Affairs Committee questions Group 4 and other prison-running private firms on the prison service, 1645 GMT. - Trade and Industry Committee publishes government response to its report on trade with India, 1200 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
